{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Verify the column names and ensure there is a patient identifier
print(df.columns)

# Check if there is a column that uniquely identifies patients
# Assuming 'patient_id' or similar might be a candidate
# If not, we can check for a column with unique values
unique_cols = [col for col in df.columns if df[col].nunique() == len(df)]
print(unique_cols)"}
